title: symphyotrichum laeve var. geyeri
intro: Symphyotrichum laeve var. geyeri, commonly known as Geyer's panicled aster, is a flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to the United States and Canada. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Geyer's panicled aster are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe irritated tissues and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
